t: This Luceco solar-powered LED wall light provides reliable outdoor illumination for various installations where wiring is problematic. It is ideal for lighting pathways, shed entrances, or garage exteriors, offering enhanced security and visibility. The integrated cool white LED delivers 220 lumens of bright light, activated by a PIR sensor with a 120-degree detection angle and 6-metre range. Built with durable polycarbonate, this IP65-rated fixture ensures robust performance in all weather conditions, while its pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor and two working modes offer energy-efficient and flexible operation without the need for mains power or transformers.
